mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when GDP is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when payroll employment is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is above 105 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signal a strong economy, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when housing starts are increasing and unemployment rate is decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP signal an easing monetary cycle and a strong economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% and GDP is above 20000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is above 150000 and unemployment rate is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in housing starts signal an easing monetary cycle and a strong economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% and housing starts are above 1400 (t-test p > 0.05).
